create_entry.default: Done. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and sign in to your school. Devices and entities appear on their own.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the Ranzenpost add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The add-on {addon} was found. Connect Home Assistant to it?

install_addon.title: Install the Ranzenpost add-on
install_addon.description: The Ranzenpost add-on is not installed yet. Add the repository {repository}, then install and start the add-on?

addon_no_discovery.title: The add-on has not announced itself
addon_no_discovery.description: The add-on {addon} is installed but has not announced its connection details yet. Open the add-on, check that it is running, and enter the host, port and token from its Home Assistant settings block.

data_description.host: Host name of the add-on container, usually shown in its settings.
data_description.port: Port of the integration API, 8099 by default.
data_description.token: Access token shown in the add-on settings.

manual.title: Connect Ranzenpost manually
manual.description: Enter the host, port and token of the running Ranzenpost container. The token is shown in the Ranzenpost settings.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Ranzenpost container.
data_description.port: Port of the integration API, 8099 by default.
data_description.token: Access token shown in the Ranzenpost settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Ranzenpost token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} was rejected. Enter the current token from the Ranzenpost settings.

progress.install_addon: The Ranzenpost add-on is being installed. This can take a few minutes.
progress.wait_discovery: Waiting for the add-on to announce its connection details.

error.cannot_connect: The add-on could not be reached. Check that it is running.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Copy it again from the Ranzenpost settings.
error.unknown: The add-on answered in an unexpected way.

abort.already_configured: This Ranzenpost add-on is already connected. Every add-on host can be connected once.
abort.already_in_progress: A Ranzenpost setup is already in progress.
abort.addon_install_failed: The Ranzenpost add-on could not be installed. Check the Supervisor log.
abort.addon_start_failed: The Ranzenpost add-on could not be started. Check the add-on log.
abort.not_ranzenpost_addon: This discovery message does not belong to the Ranzenpost add-on.

init.title: Ranzenpost options
init.description: How often the integration asks the add-on, and which profiles get entities.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two requests to the add-on, at least 30.
data_description.children: Leave empty to create entities for every profile.

login_needed.title: Sign-in needed for {school}
login_needed.description: Ranzenpost could not sign in to {school} anymore. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar, go to settings, select this school and sign in again.

login_twofactor_setup.title: Two-factor needed for {school}
login_twofactor_setup.description: IServ now requires two-factor for this account at {school}. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and finish the setup.

login_unknown_account.title: Account unknown at {school}
login_unknown_account.description: IServ at {school} no longer knows the saved account name. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and connect the school again.

login_default_password.title: Default password blocked at {school}
login_default_password.description: IServ at {school} does not accept the default password from the internet. Change the password inside the school network or in the browser, then reconnect in Ranzenpost.

login_locked.title: Account locked at {school}
login_locked.description: IServ at {school} has locked the account for now. Do not sign in again, that makes the lock last longer. Wait a while or ask the school, then open Ranzenpost.

login_code_refused.title: Code refused at {school}
login_code_refused.description: IServ at {school} keeps turning down the app's confirmation code. The app's access has to be set up again. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and set up the school from scratch.

addon_too_old.title: Update the Ranzenpost add-on
addon_too_old.description: The Ranzenpost add-on runs version {addon_version}, but this integration ({integration_version}) needs at least {required_version}. Update the add-on in the add-on store. Devices and entities appear on their own once it reports its schools again.

integration_too_old.title: Update the Ranzenpost integration
integration_too_old.description: The Ranzenpost add-on runs version {addon_version}, a feature release ahead of this integration ({integration_version}). Update the integration through HACS so both match; until then some data may be missing.

no_school_yet.title: No school signed in yet
no_school_yet.description: Done. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and sign in to your school. Devices and entities appear on their own.
